description: FULL level-1/2 Borel–Laplace median resummation of the Gevrey-1/2 binding period a_D^(n)=I(n)/n for the Hopf-deuteron (perturbative Vol=0), parameter-free at the substrate coupling. Undershoots B_D by ~40× (m_e·ReP ≤ 0.06 MeV vs 2.225); reaches B_D only at the Borel singularity 1/√2 (not a substrate qty). The full alien calculus of the dualized entanglement energy does NOT close the deuteron parameter-free; distinct-mechanism (q-rotational) route indicated. Scope-(a) negative; no fit.
verdict: Scope-(a) NEGATIVE (no fit): the FULL level-1/2 Borel–Laplace median resummation of the Gevrey-1/2 binding period, evaluated parameter-free at the substrate coupling, gives m_e·ReP ≤ 0.05974 MeV (≤ 2.69% of B_D=2.2245), undershooting by ~37×; the alien jump is smaller still. It reaches B_D only as the coupling → the Borel radius 1/√2 (the singularity), which is not a substrate quantity — so a match would require tuning the coupling (a fit). The FULL alien calculus of the dualized entanglement energy therefore does NOT close the deuteron parameter-free; the wall is a distinct-mechanism problem. The working deuteron channel is the separate q-rotational μ₀·ℏ_q·J_q² route (B_D to −9%, 0 params). This closes the resummation hypothesis for the deuteron negatively. No fit; no wiring; no tier change.
